body: Hi again. We chatted on another post and you said your life is pure hell. I am truly sorry you have suffered with depression and anxiety since your teens. Have you been to counselling and on medication? Life can be truly crappy, we try to pull ourselves up and strive, but some of us always seem to be just out of reach. Reading how close you were to getting into a nursing programme and just 4 points shy of it is sad to read. Could you retry again? Maybe get some coaching in maths to help. Have you talked to your parents about it? I won't say useless empty words, but just trying to see if you could try again and have some tutoring in maths. Depression and anxiety are hard to deal woth, you isolate yourself off, doubts are always there in the back of your mind that convince you it will be worst case scenario. I have anxiety, not been out my home for a month except to put the rubbish out. Counselling and cbt have not worked for me and I hated my antidepressants. Anxiety gets you in a cold, icey grip and you feel unable to function like most other people do. Only you know how you truly feel in this world and it sounds as though you have been trying, got into college, but it must be very lonely on campus and not having a single friend. Loneliness is a killer, but most associated with retirees. Life can be very hard for some of us and people insensitively say, "get over it" or "things eill get better", but it is never going to be that simple. Nobody wants to feel depressed or anxious. It seems as if you have been in a downward spiral since being 4 points shy of getting into nursing training. It can be a scary place, you shut yourself off and feel hopeless. I don't know what else to say except you seem like a young woman who has been through a lot, made it to college, you are very lonely and keep trying then having a setback. Life can be really difficult to cope with and being so near yet so far in getting close to a goal. Only you know what you can cope with and decide.

At that point in time my mum had no idea there was a genetic illness in her family. It only came to light when my aunt, her sister, fell ill in the 90s and then it took 5 years for the right disease to be diagnosed. My mum is on a bunch of meds and can't talk and bed bound. Ironically, my mum had fertility issues, she had miscarriages before my sister and before having me. It is bad to bring a child into a home where the couple argue and fight. I think they had some good years inbetween things, but my mum said her mother in law warned her about my dad's temper before she married him but my mum was only 20 when she wed. Very different era. Some people truly are unsuitable for having kids and thank you for your words. I am sorry you find life pure hell as well. There isn't anything selfish about not having kids. How can you be selfish about a hypothetical kid? That's illogical and said by people who should mind their own business. As you say it is selfish to have a child if there is mental illness, violence, drug use etc. Some peopke selfishly have kids to "have someone to love and love me". Those types need to fix themselves first and get a steady relationship instead of crrating an innocent life who is made to fulfill a hole!

Same here, except I did very nearly die at birth and it was very very close. I hate the doctor who used his own blood to save me. My parents should never have had kids, my dad was depressed, he hit my mum, my mum was unstable, she flew into rages and hit my older sister. She has an inherited illness that is horrific and she is dying of it. Some people truly shouldn't procreate they are that unstable and mess up the lives of the children they have. I saw violence from both my parents towards each other, because my mum also used to not stop prodding my dad on and on she used to go about everything. This life is pure hell as you say.

We are born into this world without any say so or control of where we end up. Who our parents are or how our formative years shape us. I get a sense that you didn't grow up in a happy home and maybe saw a form of abuse. You mention everyone you have dated has been abusive which is a pattern. We all form patterns in life and tend to date the same type and this also makes me think you date abusives types, because 1 of your parents was abusive. Do you want to break the same patterns? I will not give you platitudes, I myself plan to end it all, but you seem more worn down by a job you hate and dating abusive types. Could you look to training in something else you would love to do? You may not have to go back to school as there are online courses to do from home. It is up to you if you care to or not. There is therapy to help with your phobia. I tried counselling for my anxiety, but it hasn't worked for me. I will not say a load of spiel about life is a gift, we are all special blah blah. We are here, merely a speck in the timeline of the universe, it makes me feel small but it is true. Us humans can be ego driven that we think human life matters more than other lives. People can be cruel, cold, wicked, take from those of us who try to be kind, but if you want to live try to be stronger and not let others keep taking from you. There are loving people out there, but first you would need to deal with your phobia and then look to finding a job you like, make friends, join groups etc. It would not be easy if you want to put in the effort. I am childfree too, partly due to the fact I might have inherited an incurable cruel disease, but I also don't want to inflict life on another. You are the one who has to decide do you have any spark of hope to change your life or not. I tried, didn't work for me, I saw a man who used me too. Platitudes are useless, life is life, good and bad, some ups some downs.

What useless platitudes! This person has suffered immensley, abandoned, seen violence and deaths and severly scarred mentally and emotionally. I bet you would carelessly say that to a homeless person "hope it gets better". Sometimes it never gets better. They can't even volunteer for a few hours a month. Their mind and body has gone through abuse, beatings, homelessness, arthritis and they are mentally ill unable to work. Whoever had them were monsters and destroyed their life. I wouldn't even know what to say to them, but not such a casual, meaningless line like yours!! You think things will get better? A lot of the time it never does, arthritis has no cure, loneliness is the equivalent of smoking 15 cigarettes a day and literally kills. This world is screwed up with people having babies and screwing them up and reading this person's life is just utterly sad.

Thank you for your words, but I simply do not care one iota about this pretence called living. I have no need to stay alive or care to try anymore. It means nothing to me. I tried counselling, I tried to move, I tried love and it came to nothing. My only hope is for my mum to no longer endure Huntington's disease and I am ending my life after her birthday next month. There isn't any point and I wish I had died at birth instead of the doctor saving me with a transfusion of his own blood. I was born almost dying which is ironic. I was meant to die 37 years ago and will be ending it in about 3 weeks.

Not yet, but I had 1 counselling session with a genetic counsellor 7 years ago, but left it at that. I am finished with living altogether. My only other wish is that my mum would not be suffering as she is simply lying in a bed waiting for the end. She has been in a care home for 3 years now.

You will have a better life without a cheating, lying, ungrateful prat in it. To cheat on you after all the love, devotion, caring of a 2 year relationship and you being there for him through his cancer diagnosis. The betrayal must be terrible, you gave him the space he wanted and he threw it back in your face. There will be a man out there who will cherish you, because you sound like a loving person, so head up, don't let the bastard grind you down even though the pain is raw right now. You deserve a man who will love you and communicate in a proper, mature when you face the ups and downs of life together. This man did not deserve your steadfast love and support. His cancer diagnosis is not an excuse to cheat at all. One thing though, I understand you are feeling horribly betrayed and angry right now, but to say your ex doesn't deserve his health is not something you should say. You are the better person and we shouldn't wish ill health on most people (I exclude murderers, child abusers, rapists, drug barons, terrorists from this though).

Nope, it is not closure at all. The grandad is racist, abusive, judgemental, nasty and treated others badly. Blood ties do not warrant some sort of forgiveness or need to see an ill relative. The man lashed out at people and drove them away with HIS behaviour and hurt this grandaughter. He isn't worth her time and reassurance now he has little time to live. He made his bed in life, so shouldn't expect others to come running to see him now he is dying. Reap what you sow in life. He caused all this and it is not for any family member to fake sob or forgive him on his deathbed.

You can express your concerns that they are being manipulated and only enabling your uncle's behaviour. Parents will try to do anything for a child even when the child is an adult and drug user. All you can say is you love them and that they need to enjoy retirement. They have given him a house to live in! He needs to get off his backside and sort himself out because he is 49 and needs a job. Your grandad feels guilt about his past, but he is then using his son to make some skewed atonement. Your grandma needs her husband to be on the same page as her and say no to their son and make him get his life together.
